stockScan.confirmExpiryMismatch: The barcode says this batch expires ${scannedDate}, but it is recorded as expiring ${recordedDate}. The recorded date will be used. Continue?
stockScan.confirmNewLot: Batch ${lotCode} expiring ${expiryDate} is not recorded here. It will be created when this page is submitted. Add it?
stockScan.lotCreationNotAllowed: Batch ${lotCode} is not recorded here, and you do not have permission to add batches. Ask an administrator to register it.
stockScan.lotNotOnScreen: Batch ${lotCode} is not available here. Check the stock on hand and the expiry date, or enter this item manually.
stockScan.lotRequired: This product is tracked by batch, but the barcode carries no batch number. Enter this item manually.
stockScan.productAmbiguous: Barcode ${gtin} matches more than one product on this screen. Select the product manually.
stockScan.productNotOnScreen: No product with barcode ${gtin} is available on this screen. Check that it is in this program and has stock on hand.
